response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(l.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), shares AS (SELECT product_color, invoiced, invoiced * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced) OVER () AS share, AVG(invoiced) OVER () AS avg_invoiced FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(invoiced - avg_invoiced) AS avg_excess_over_color_average FROM shares WHERE invoiced > avg_invoiced

assumptions.assumption: Invoiced amount is the sum of Invoice_Line_Items.derived_total_cost (VAT included) for each color, with the color taken from Products via product_id.
Products with NULL color form one group. Empty-string colors, if any, would be a separate group.
The per-color average is the average of the color totals across all color groups, including the no-color group. Share is a color's total divided by the sum of all color totals.
Only colors that appear on at least one invoice line are counted.

alternatives.interpretation: Invoiced amount is the pre-VAT cost (derived_product_cost) instead of the total cost including VAT.
